changeNote_1_2_0: NPAMP-REG 30_protocol_registry.md §8.4 widening (ecosystem-viral-wire #1/D1): bridge-protocol-id-value widened from u8 to u16 big-endian on the wire (NPAMP-BRIDGE 10_bridge_framework.md §4); the annotated code-point literals are unchanged numerically (0x01 == 0x0001) but the range comment now reads four-hex-digit and the ranges alternation gains the newly-opened extended standards-assigned range 0x0100..0xFFFF, a genuine grammar widening (more values now accepted), hence a minor version bump.
changeNote_1_1_1: P2.10 (2026-09-02): corrected the ml-dsa-87 sig-scheme code point from an erroneous 0x0905 (reserved for ML-DSA-65, unused by any profile) to the registry-correct 0x0906 (registries/signatures.csv:5; impl/go/suites.go:31), in the sigs group and the CertVerify Value comment. No grammar/structure change -- a value correction only.
sha256Note: SHA-256 over the raw bytes of schema/npamp-wire.cddl, the same algorithm and value scripts/verify-pins.ps1 checks via MANIFEST.sha256. This manifest's sha256 field is a second, independent recording of that same content hash (recomputed with Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 during authoring and confirmed to match MANIFEST.sha256's schema/npamp-wire.cddl entry) so a consumer of ONLY this manifest -- without cloning the whole repository or parsing MANIFEST.sha256 -- can still detect drift between the CDDL artifact it fetched and the version this manifest describes.
scopeNote: This CDDL constrains ONLY lengths and permitted bit-sets/values for the N-PAMP wire-format-version-2 binary frame layout; it cannot express big-endianness, octet concatenation order, or the octet-4 Ver/Flags nibble split (RFC 8610 has no such primitives -- see the file's own header comment, 'HONEST SCOPE CAVEAT'). Byte-exact wire properties are graded separately by the conformance corpus (test-vectors/v1/conformance-corpus.json) and by impl/go/wirevalidator (registry-driven structural + registry validation, not a CDDL interpreter).

referenceValidator.tool: cddl (Ruby gem, Carsten Bormann's RFC 8610 reference implementation)
referenceValidator.checks: grammar well-formedness only (RFC 8610 syntax); does NOT validate any concrete frame's bytes

versioningPolicy: cddlArtifactVersion follows semver and is bumped on every change to schema/npamp-wire.cddl's content (i.e. whenever its sha256 changes). A consumer pins {artifactPath, cddlArtifactVersion, sha256} together; impl/go/schemaversion.VerifyManifest recomputes the sha256 from the on-disk file and fails closed on any mismatch, so this manifest and the CDDL file cannot silently drift apart.
